To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the Peg3 antisense transcript, APeg3 is expressed specifically in the rat supraoptiic nucleus magnocellular neurons and that APeg3 and Peg3 gene expression in these neurons is increased during systemic hyperosmolar stress.
the APeg3 antisense RNA, which is transcribed in a direction opposite to that of Peg3, is specifically expressed in vasotocinergic magnocellualr neurons (MCNs).

we report here the robust, cell-specific expression in the VP MCNs of an RNA that is transcribed from the Peg3 locus in the antisense orientation and that we demonstrate that the APeg3 mRNA and protein are predominantly expressed in VP MCNs and are upregulated in response to hyperosmolality.
In summary, our research is concerned with

understanding the molecular mechanisms that regulate the expression of genes that are expressed in the VP- and OT-MCNs and is focused on understanding how the VP and OT MCNs are specified to produce the appropriate peptide.
the expression of the Peg3 and APG3 genes in the HNS.
the identification and characterization of a novel paternality expressed gene 3, antisense RNA (APeg3), that is expressed exclusively in the VP-MCNS.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
APeg3, a new gene, is expressed in VP-MCNS and may play a role in the physiology of the HNS.
the APeg3 gene encodes a 93 amino acid protein that is expressed specifically in the VP-MCNS, and its expression is osmoregulated.
the expression of the APeg3 gene in the VP-MCNS is a novel finding that may play a role in the regulation of the VP and/or OT genes.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
APeg3 is a novel paternallly-expressed gene 3 antisence RNA transcript, and it is preferentially expressed in VP-MCNS in the rat supraoptc nucleus.
the Peg3 gene is expressed from the paternal allele in the VP-MCNS, and the APeg3 transcript is expressed in the antisense orientation to the Peg3 gene in the same cells.
the Peg3 and APe3g3 genes are both expressed in the VP neurons, and both are osmoregulation.
The main takeaway from our work is that

APeg3 is a novel paternality imprinted antisense transcript expressed exclusively in the VP-MCNS and is a member of a growing class of imprinted genes that are expressed from the paternal allele in the VP-MCNNs and are involved in the osmoregulation of VP.
APeg3 is the first antisense RNA transcript identified in the HNS, and the expression of this transcript in the VP-MCNS is regulated by osmolality.
the Peg3 locus, like the VP/OT genes, has an additional transcript expressed specifically in the VP-MCNS that is regulated by systemic hyperosmolarity.
